verdict: Paid ads have been off since August 6 — leads need follow-up now.
narrative: Meta advertising paused on August 6 and has remained dark for 18 days, so the 29 leads and $741.52 in spend reported this period all belong to the earlier active window, not the current week. Every one of those 29 contacts is sitting unworked — no appointments have been set and no opportunities have been moved forward in pipeline, which is the most urgent business issue right now. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile activity is up 16% week over week and search clicks are up a comparable amount, showing that demand for your services hasn't softened even while paid is off. Ads are being reactivated and lead follow-up automation is being stood up by August 31 so that no future leads sit idle. Next period you should see fresh paid leads entering a pipeline that is actively working them.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from before August 6 when ads were active
cost per lead during the active paid window
rise in Google Business Profile activity this week, showing steady organic demand

watch_item.issue: All 29 leads from this period are uncontacted — no appointments or next steps have been logged against them.
watch_item.fix: Lead follow-up automation and SMS outreach are being activated by August 31 to work through the existing contacts immediately.
